# Copilot instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root: the hard rules (this kit is read-only and must never trade; no secrets;
no financial advice; private files stay git-ignored) and the job table. Each job's steps are in
`.claude/skills/<job>/SKILL.md`; on a fresh clone with no `config.json`, follow `.claude/skills/setup/SKILL.md`.
